dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Antiphospholipid syndrome (neurological manifestations with chorea, cerebellar ataxia, and renal impairment)

Alternative 1: Systemic lupus erythematosus with neuropsychiatric involvement
Alternative 2: Celiac disease with cerebellar ataxia and chorea as extraintestinal manifestations
Alternative 3: Late-onset metabolic movement disorder (e.g., chorea-acanthocytosis or mitochondrial disorder)
